limitations: Digital prototype; physical printing, assembly, fit, durability and operation have not been tested.
Motion verification was disabled. Expression changes are design intent until tested on a physical prototype.
product.summary: A mechanical desk seesaw with a warm brown bull and a charcoal bear. Tilting the beam is designed to reveal a bull's smile on the rising bull side and blue tears on the rising bear side.
product.title: Bull Bear Seesaw
